Lazio|Lazio]] | team2association = | team2score = 2 | details = | date = 15 May 2019 | stadium = [[Stadio Olimpico]] | city = [[Rome]] | man_of_the_match1a = | man_of_the_match1atitle = | man_of_the_match1b = | man_of_the_match1btitle = | referee = [[Luca Banti]] | attendance = 57,059 | weather = | previous = [[2018 Coppa Italia final|2018]] | next = [[2020 Coppa Italia final|2020]] }} The '''2019 Coppa Italia final''' decided the winner of the [[2018–19 Coppa Italia]], Italy's main football cup.{{cite web|url=http://www.legaseriea.it/uploads/default/attachments/comunicati/comunicati_m/7689/files/allegati/7743/1_-_regolamento_coppa_italia_ss_18-19__19-20__20-21.pdf|title=Coppa Italia 2018/2019, 2019/2020 e 2020/2021|publisher=legaseriea.it|language=it|access-date=18 July 2018|date=9 July 2018|archive-date=28 December 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201228115801/http://www.legaseriea.it/uploads/default/attachments/comunicati/comunicati_m/7689/files/allegati/7743/1_-_regolamento_coppa_italia_ss_18-19__19-20__20-21.pdf|url-status=dead}} It was played on 15 May 2019 at the [[Stadio Olimpico]] in [[Rome]] between [[Atalanta B.C.|Atalanta]] and [[S.S. Lazio|Lazio]]. This was the first-ever meeting between these two clubs in the final. Lazio won the match 2–0, winning their seventh title overall, from 10 finals appearances.{{cite web|url=https://www.football-italia.net/138092/coppa-italia-atalanta-bow-lazio|title=Coppa Italia: Atalanta bow to Lazio|publisher=Football Italia|date=15 May 2019}} Atalanta made its fourth finals appearance, and have now lost three consecutive finals after winning their only title in [[1963 Coppa Italia Final|1963]].{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/48285632|title =Atalanta 0 Lazio 2|date=15 May 2019|work=BBC Sport|access-date=16 May 2019}}{{cite web|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/blog/2019/may/16/lazio-bring-atalanta-down-to-earth-with-coppa-italia-triumph|title =Lazio bring Atalanta down to earth with Coppa Italia triumph|date=16 May 2019|work=Guardian|access-date=16 May 2019}} As the cup winners, Lazio automatically qualified to the group stage of the [[2019–20 UEFA Europa League]] and to the [[2019 Supercoppa Italiana]] against [[Juventus FC|Juventus]]. {{TOC left}} {{clear}} ==Road to the final== ''Note: In all results below, the score of the finalist is given first (H: home; A: away).'' {| width="100%" style="text-align:center" |- valign=top bgcolor=#99ccff !colspan=2 style="width:40%"|[[Atalanta B.C.|Atalanta]] !Round !colspan=2 style="width:40%"|[[S.S.
